literal: Income having increased, wealth having created, things that occur he who examines, let him do the task.
translation: Entrust a task to one who can expand sources of income, create wealth, and analyze any obstacles that arise.
modern: வருவாய்க்கான வழிகளைப் பெருக்கி, செல்வத்தை வளர்த்து, வரும் இடையூறுகளை ஆராய்ந்து தீர்க்க வல்லவனிடம் ஒரு செயலை ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of an ideal administrator or manager to whom a task should be entrusted. The chosen person must be capable of expanding sources of income and generating wealth. Furthermore, they must have the foresight and analytical skill to examine and resolve any obstacles that occur during the execution of the work. Only someone with these three abilities should be assigned the responsibility of a major task.
